title: Chuyin Unmasks First Billboard No. 1 With ‘Pues Qué Le Hago?’
summary: The masked artist keeps his charts streak going with a chart-topper on Regional Mexican Airplay.
contentText:
Following his top 10 albums chart breakthrough in May, masked artist Chuyin earns his first No. 1 on a Billboard chart, as “Pues Qué le Hago?” rockets from No. 7 to the top of the Regional Mexican Airplay chart (dated Sept. 12) — his first appearance on the tally.

In May, Chuyin crashed the top 10 of the Regional Mexican Albums chart with his debut album, Los Locos Nunca Mueren , which opened at No. 9 — marking Street Mob Records’ first top 10 debut among six 2026 entries. The set’s “Pues Qué le Hago?” has become a radio favorite, spending 14 of its 18 weeks on the Regional Mexican Airplay chart’s upper region.

“Pues Qué le Hago?” rallies 7-1 on Regional Mexican Airplay powered by 6.4 million audience impressions, earned in the United States, during the tracking week ending Sept. 3, according to Luminate; that’s a 29% growth in weekly impressions.

On the overall Latin Airplay chart, “Pues Qué le Hago?” surges 13-2 with the Greatest Gainer honors, awarded weekly to the title with the biggest increase in audience. The move also marks Chuyin’s highest peak on overall Latin radio ranking, after it reached No. 9 high in June.

Beyond its coronation on Regional Mexican Airplay and its new peak on Latin Airplay, “Pues Qué le Hago?” also advances to its highest ranking yet on Hot Regional Mexican Songs , climbing 10-6.

As for Chuyin’s album Los Locos Nunca Mueren , despite having fallen out of the top 10, the set adds a 17th week on the Regional Mexican Albums chart, as it jumps 22-21.
